many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

# Fill color rule: fill = dot color nearest to box center. Verify on all demos.
def solve(g):
    Cs,D=analyze(g)
    boxes=sorted(Cs,key=lambda b:(b['r0'],b['c0']))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    pick=Counter()
    for i,b in enumerate(boxes):
        cr,cc=(b['r0']+b['r1'])//2,(b['c0']+b['c1'])//2
        cands={min((abs(i-cr)+abs(j-cc),c)) for i,j,c in D if c!=g[cr][cc]} and [(min(),c)]
        dmin=min(abs(i-cr)+abs(j-cc) for i,j,c in D if c!=g[b['col']])
        best=[c for i,j,c in D if (abs(i-cr)+abs(j-cc))==dmin and c!=g[b['col']]]
        pick[cands]=None
        print('box',b,'center',(cr,cc),'nearest dot colors:',best)
    return out,pick,Cs,D

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    p=d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl'
    t=open(p).read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G,Gs or {}  # keep old

def comps2(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while stack:

    while True:
        if not Cands[-1]: break

    # simpler: recursive glob across whole system state dir
